structured.answer: According to the page, I'd keep it in an account at "פסגות ניירות ערך בע"מ", in the fund "ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500". After 15 years of 750 ₪ a month I'd have about 179,889 ₪ "בכסף של היום". That's against 135,000 ₪ put in, and it assumes prices go up 2% a year and the fund earns 7% a year. Before I do anything I'll ask you or the bank.

stuck.why: It opens with English letters (S&P 500, MSCI) on a dark background, which made me feel the page isn't for me. I only stayed because I'd been given the task.
No number for it shows on the main screen, only a button saying "אינפלציה". I had to open a box to see the 2%.
The colors are close together and the numbers inside the bars are tiny. I couldn't tell which cost was which without the small legend.

used: Boxes: סכום היום 0, הפקדה חודשית 750, שנים 15
Result 179,889 ₪, "נשאר לכם בעוד 15 שנים, אחרי דמי ניהול ומס, בכסף של היום"
Inflation box: "אינפלציה בשנה 2%", "בכמה המחירים עולים בשנה, בממוצע"
Account פסגות ניירות ערך בע"מ and fund ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D)
skimmed: The S&P 500 description under the heading
skipped: Fund details: דמי ניהול, משתנות, נאמן 0.02%
unsure_meaning: מדד (here it means something else than the price index)
"בכסף של היום": does 179,889 already take off the 2%?
not_found: Any comparison to a bank deposit
Any warning in plain words that the fund can go down
Inflation number shown on the main screen without opening a box

findings.what: The page opens with English index names and a dark screen, which frightens someone looking for safe saving
I couldn't see the inflation assumption (2%) without opening a box
Small grey text under the numbers is hard to read even enlarged
findings.where: Lines under the result boxes, "אם הדולר לא זז מול השקל"

findings.what: The cost bar has close colors and tiny numbers. The big pink tax bar (15,364) is alarming and comes without a plain sentence
The minus sign −122 ₪ made me stop, but it's only the gap between two choices
Nothing says the 7% isn't guaranteed or that the fund can fall
Words like קרן מחקה, נאמן, דמי משמרת aren't explained where they appear
